chunks: My father narrated to me from Sa'd ibn 'Abdillah, from Abu 'Abdillah Muhammad ibn Abu 'Abdillah al-Razi al-Jamurani, from al-Husayn ibn Sayf ibn 'Amirah, from his father Sayf, from Abu Bakr al-Hadrami, from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) or from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

I asked him, 'Which part of the earth is the most superior after the Sanctuary of Allah (Exalted and Mighty) and the Sanctuary of His Messenger (peace be upon him and his family)?' He replied, 'Kufah, O Abu Bakr! It is the purified and virtuous land. It contains the graves of the sent prophets, the graves of those who were not sent, and the truthful successors. It contains the Mosque of Suhayl, in which every prophet sent by Allah had prayed. From it, the Justice of Allah will appear, and its Qa'im (Rising One) and those who will lead after him will be in it. It is indeed the abodes of the prophets, the successors, and the righteous ones.'

key_terms.عَدْلُ اللَّهِ: the Justice of Allah (referring to the Mahdi)

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual significance of Kufah in Shia Islam according to this hadith?
ai.summary: In Kamil al-Ziyarat, Ibn Qulawayh records this tradition linking Kufah’s sanctity to its role as the cradle of the Mahdi’s emergence, a central eschatological theme in Shia thought. The narration underscores the city’s unique status as the resting place of prophets, imams, and the 'truthful successors' (al-Awsiya), while also noting the Mosque of Suhayl as a universal place of worship where every prophet prayed. This elevates Kufah from a mere historical site to a theological axis connecting prophetic lineage, imamate, and the ultimate establishment of divine justice.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 11. My father narrated to me from Sa’d ibn ‘Abdillāh, from Abī ‘Abdillāh Muḥammad ibn Abī ‘Abdillāh Al-Rāzi Al-Jāmūrāni, from Ḥusain ibn Sayf ibn ‘Amīrah, from his father Sayf, from Abī Bakr Al-Ḥaďrami, who said:

I asked Abā ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) or Abā Ja’far (Imam Bāqir (a.s.)), “What is the best place after Masjid Al-Ḥarām and the Mosque of the Prophet (s.a.a.w.)?” Imam (a.s.) replied: Kūfah. O Abā Bakr! Kūfah is the purified and the virtuous land. It contains the graves of the messengers, the prophets, and the truthful successors. It (also) contains the Mosque of Suhayl in which every prophet sent by Allāh has prayed. The Justice of Allāh (the Twelfth Imam (a.s.)) will (also) reappear from this city. The rising Imam (a.s.) and those who will lead after him will also live in it. It is indeed the abode of the prophets, the successors, and the righteous ones.
